class.name: Mover
class.brief_description: A 3D node that can be controlled via touch/swipe input.
class.description:
The Mover class extends [Node3D] and provides touch-based control for rotating or moving 3D objects. It handles screen touch and drag events, allowing users to interact with the node by swiping on the screen. The node supports two control modes: rotation mode (default) and movement mode.
In rotation mode, horizontal swipes rotate the node around the Y-axis (yaw), and vertical swipes rotate around the X-axis (pitch). In movement mode, horizontal swipes move the node along the X-axis, and vertical swipes move along the Z-axis.

method.name: get_control_mode
method.description: Returns the current control mode. 0 = rotation mode, 1 = movement mode.

method.name: handle_touch_begin
method.description: Called when a touch begins. Stores the initial touch position.

method.name: handle_touch_drag
method.description: Called when the user drags their finger across the screen. Updates the node's rotation or position based on the control mode.

method.name: handle_touch_end
method.description: Called when a touch ends. Resets the touch state.

method.name: set_control_mode
method.description: Sets the control mode. 0 = rotation mode, 1 = movement mode.

method.name: set_move_speed
method.description: Sets the movement speed multiplier. Higher values result in faster movement.

method.name: set_rotation_speed
method.description: Sets the rotation speed multiplier. Higher values result in faster rotation.

members.member: The control mode for the node. 0 = rotation mode (default), 1 = movement mode.
The movement speed multiplier. Controls how fast the node moves when in movement mode.
The rotation speed multiplier. Controls how fast the node rotates when in rotation mode.
